# AniStream v2.2.3

Fixes for full screen in the movie and show players, the Next episode prompt cutting episodes
short, and downloaded episodes missing their previews and Skip buttons offline.

## Better

- ⚡️ Downloaded episodes are ready for offline: AniStream now saves each episode's preview image
  and its opening and ending times when you download it, so they're there without a connection.
  Episodes you downloaded before get them the next time AniStream is online
- ⚡️ Movies & TV waits for the end: The Next episode prompt and its countdown now appear when the
  episode has finished, not during the credits next to the player's own Next button
- 💄 The Next episode prompt in Movies & TV sits higher, clear of the player's own time display

## Fixed

- 🦺 Full screen from a movie or show player's own button showed a black screen while the sound
  kept playing. Pressing the button again now also leaves full screen
- 🦺 The Next episode countdown in Movies & TV could start in the credits and skip ahead before the
  episode was over
- 🦺 Offline, most downloaded episodes had no preview image and no Skip opening or Skip ending
  button
- 🦺 Pressing Play on an episode while the episode list was still loading could switch to the
  episode you were part-way through instead

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.2.3-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.2.3.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream downloads this update in the background and installs it when you choose
**Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session
are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Check a download against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or confirm it was built by this
project's release workflow with
`gh attestation verify AniStream.Setup.2.2.3.exe --repo Athen2045/AniStream`.
